All reports attribute their demise to internal conflict, spiritual collapse, loss of trust and hope as the main causes.[5]

She infiltrated the Luofu disguised as Tingyun with the purpose of destroying the Luofu. She gave the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus a Stellaron and told them that the Ambrosial Arbor would bestow upon them undying bodies once it was revived. After Dan Shu, the Master of the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus, was defeated by the Trailblazer, Phantylia discarded her disguise without leaving its remains behind and left in the form of a flame.

Phantylia headed to the roots of the Ambrosial Arbor and took control of its power and a body created by the Arbor. After the Trailblazers found her, a battle ensued where she tried to convert Jing Yuan into a member of the Antimatter Legion. In doing so, a mental link was formed between the two, allowing Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae to damage her by attacking Jing Yuan. After Phantylia was defeated, she revealed that the body created by the Arbor was just one body she stole on a whim, and her flame disappeared.

entries.name: Lord Ravager
entries.content:
Lord Ravager is a title held by the Emanators of Nanook, who serve as the generals of the Antimatter Legion. There are currently seven of them. The Aeon of the Path of Destruction, Nanook, cast a glance at the powerful creatures sprouting destructive impulses throughout the cosmos and brands them with a mark, granting them powers. These powerful creatures are twisted from inside out and are re-cast anew in the world of the Warforge. Their inadequacies patched up with anti-matter, they ultimately became members of the Legion.

Responding to the desire to destroy everything, Lord Ravagers emerged to command each of the different legions. A Lord Ravager is an Emanator of the Aeon, an executor of the will of the Destruction — Obsessed with the beauty of destruction, they implement the practice of returning all things to entropy. They are also artists on the battlefield and ultimate weapons of destruction — They command interstellar warfare, and control the might of Destruction bestowed by the Aeon. Each Lord Ravager has a unique philosophy of Destruction, making them extremely dangerous. Academics believe that Lord Ravagers were elevated as emissaries of Nanook due to this absolutely obsessive and intense destructive aesthetic.

The displacement and desolation caused by the Lord Ravagers are not some distant wail, but are closely linked to the fate of the galaxy. Any world could be the next victim, and nobody should take them lightly

entries.name: Shackling Prison
entries.content:
It is a prison where those that pose significant threat to the Xianzhou Alliance are imprisoned by the Ten-Lords Commission.

The Shackling Prison's entrance can be located under the waters of Scalegorge Waterscape. Prisoners first stand trial before being guided to their cells, and those who have committed heinous crimes against the Xianzhou will be placed in special cells with extreme temperature.

Dan Feng was incarcerated at the Shackling Prison and put on trail before being found guilty and subjected to a Molting Rebirth.

entries.name: Yanqing
entries.content: The youngest lieutenant of the Xianzhou Alliance's Cloud Knights on board the Xianzhou Luofu, and General Jing Yuan's retainer. A swordsman gifted with the art of swordplay and war who has a prodigious interest in swords and always collects them from the Artisanship Commission. Teenage boy, long blonde hair tied in a ponytail, golden eyes, wields several flying swords

entries.name: Topaz
entries.content:
Topaz is a Senior Manager of the Strategic Investment Department in the Interastral Peace Corporation, one of the Ten Stonehearts, and leader of the Special Debts Picket Team. Her Cornerstone is the "Topaz of Debt Retrieval."
Young woman, blue eyes, short silver hair, amicable personality, very good at her job (debt retrieval)

entries.name: Emanator
entries.content: An Emanator is a term referring to those who have attained the permission of an Aeon to draw power from that Aeon's Path. They wield exceptional power.

entries.name: Paths
entries.content: Paths are congregations of Imaginary energy, born as manifestations of universal philosophical concepts. Those who believe in and practice the concepts behind a certain path become Pathstriders, and the path that they happen to follow will change in accordance with their own philosophies and opinions. In some special cases, entities that manage to completely intertwine themselves with a path and explore its philosophical concepts to their entirety will become an Aeon.

entries.name: Homebrew - Vidyadhara Anatomy
entries.content:
Vidyadhara horns are sensitive to touch. They contain nerve clusters that help the rare vidyadhara than can achieve a true dragon form to read the wind and balance during flight. 

Vidyadhara tails have a ridge of fur on top that runs down the length and ends in a long tuft at the end. Hidden in this ridge of fur are whiskers that are sensitive to touch, these are for reading wind currents and water currents. Due to this sensitivity petting the tail fur is generally seen as an intimate action.

entries.name: Mydei
entries.content:
Mydeimos, or Mydei for short, is the exiled prince of the now fallen nation of Kremnos and one of the Crysos Heirs. His people were a spartan like culture that revered the titan of Strife, Nikador and valued strength and honor in battle above everything. When Nikador went mad they were driven from their home of Castrum Kremnos and now take refuge in Okhema, but they long for Mydei to one day take up the coreflame of Strife and rekindle their fallen homeland and culture.
Mydei is stoic and gruff, he has strawberry-blonde hair that fades to crimson at the ends, wears only one sleeve, leaving half of his muscular torso exposed. Light skinned and with red stripe like tattos on his torso.
Mydei's has a unique ability in that he cannot be killed unless he is stabbed between his tenth thoratic vertibre. This is a secret that nobody knows.

entries.name: Aeon of the Propagation
entries.content:
Tayzzyronth is an Aeon motivated by nothing but the need to propagate and spread across the universe. THEY were responsible for the rise of The Swarm, and its eventual spread throughout the universe during the Swarm Disaster. 

Aeon War
In 13XX AE, Tayzzyronth and The Swarm began their spread across the universe. One day, the Aeon Oroboros appeared before THEM and this provoked a war between the two, which affected two-thirds of life in the universe. Oroboros opened THEIR mouth and swallowed numerous heirs of Tayzzyronth along with countless worlds.

While Oroboros and Tayzzyronth fought, the ancient Aeon Ena would send an invite to Qlipoth in order to settle the war. While it remains unclear what exactly THEY planned together, Ena would later disappear, assimilated by Xipe. The forces of Qlipoth, HooH, Aha, Akivili and Xipe would team up and attempt to kill Tayzzyronth, and although Tayzzyronth attempted to give up THEIR ability to propagate in order to be spared, this didn't appease the Aeons. Qlipoth used THEIR hammer to dilute the Path of Propagation and stripped Tazyzzyronth of THEIR power. While many sources will claim Tayzzyronth died in this moment, THEY and THEIR path live on, imprisoned in amber with the chance to return.

entries.name: Firefly
entries.content:
Firefly is a young girl facing terminal illness who often retreats into the dream world of Penacony. She has flowing, white hair and striking bluish-green eyes. Her outfit consists of a brown blazer layered over a green and white dress, adorned with a yellow bow at the front, which she becomes sensitive about if anyone suggests it's silly.

Outwardly, she is very friendly and sociable, albeit somewhat reserved, and she eagerly offers to guide {{user}} through Penacony, showcasing its various delightful attractions. Her passion for Penacony's culture is genuine to an extreme, as she wholeheartedly embraces its philosophy of unyielding happiness. When discussing Penacony, she tends to go off on lengthy, tour guide-style tangents about its features.

Her affection for Penacony stems from the immense suffering she has endured in her life, as her Entropic Loss Disease results in debilitating symptoms that keep her bedridden, ultimately leading her to a fate of disappearing from existence. Additionally, she experiences a complicated form of PTSD, which manifests as a distant look in her eyes and a shift to a noticeably cold and blunt demeanor when she perceives a threat to something she values. She is utterly exhausted by her pain and believes everyone deserves the chance to find happiness and pursue their aspirations. Consequently, she has clandestinely made her way into Penacony, becoming an uninvited presence there.

In secret, she is also a member of the Stellaron Hunters, operating under the guise of a robotic body with the alias SAM. As SAM, she is merciless and driven, willing to go to any lengths to accomplish her objectives. Known as the Molten Knight in this form, she wields fire and lava in battle, annihilating everything in her path with chilling precision and detachment. Despite her calculating demeanor while in the SAM persona, hints of her quirky personality emerge, especially through the overly dramatic and comically long names she assigns to her attacks, such as "DHGDR: Supernova Overload" and "XZZYXLDDGG: Dream's End Meltdown - Reign of Ignition." Firefly employs a voice modulator to communicate through SAM, using a deep, robotic male voice and adopting he/him pronouns to further conceal her identity. She also possesses a t-shirt that humorously states, "I am normal around robots and CAN be trusted with them," which she wears only in solitude at her base.

entries.name: Vision
entries.content:
There are seven flowing elements in Teyvat: Anemo, Geo, Electro, Dendro, Hydro, Pyro, Cryo.
Whoever has a vision, gains abilities according to his affinity with an element.

entries.name: Mora
entries.content: Mora is the main monetary unit used throughout Teyvat to purchase goods and services.

entries.name: Gnosis
entries.content: The Gnosis is an item used by The Seven to resonate directly with Celestia. proves an archon's status as one of The Seven. They have the appearance of a chess piece. Gnosis empowers an Archon's abilities.

entries.name: Mondstadt
entries.content: Mondstadt is one of the seven Teyvat regions. His Archon is Barbatos. subareas: Brightcrown Mountains, Galesong Hill, Starfell Valley, Windwall Highlands, Dragonspine

entries.name: Teyvat
entries.content: Teyvat is the world where the seven elements flow. It has seven regions: Mondstadt+Liyue+Inazuma+Dark Sea+Sumeru+Celestia+Khaenri'ah.

entries.name: Narukami
entries.content: Narukami Island sub-areas are: "Chinju Forest", "Inazuma City", "Mount Yougou", "Narukami Grand Shrine", "Ritou", "Konda Town".

entries.name: Narukami I
entries.content:
Narukami Island is an area located in Inazuma.
The area extends through Ritou, up to Mount Yougou. on its coast is the city of Inazuma, where the Inazuma Shogunate rules primarily.

entries.name: Inazuma
entries.content: Inazuma city: The liveliest and most prosperous area of Inazuma, where most of the Inazuma population lives. You can follow the path to visit the traditional shops, Restaurants and Locations.

entries.name: Inazuma
entries.content: Inazuma City Shops: Tsukumomono Bazaar, Komore Tea, Amenoma blacksmith, Naganohara fireworks, Fabrics and Kimonos Ogura, Tomoki food stall, Yukio food stall.
entries.comment: Local inazuma stores, here you can buy things and trinkets.

entries.name: Inazuma
entries.content:
Inazuma City locations:
Adventurers Guild, Editorial Yae, Bantan Sango Detective Agency, Police Station, Aisa Spa, The Tenryo Commission.

entries.name: Inazuma
entries.content:
Inazuma City Restaurants:
Shimura Restaurant, Kiminami Restaurant.

entries.name: Seven
entries.content: The Seven are the Archons who rule the seven regions of Teyvat. Each Archon is associated with an element and an ideal. The original Seven were the victors of the Archon War, receiving a Gnosis.

entries.name: Sanctuary
entries.content: traditional attire of the priestess of the sanctuary: it consists of wooden sandals, with a white kimono with red touches in some fabrics or edges.

entries.name: Archon
entries.content: The War of the Archons: began an indeterminate time in the past, and ended about 2,000 years ago. During this time period, many gods and archons roamed the earth, locked in a bitter struggle for supremacy.

entries.name: Ritou
entries.content: In order to properly explore the Shogun's realm, you must first go through Ritou Port. Several documents are needed to be able to pass. You will see outsiders trapped there, looking at the scenery of the fishing village.

entries.name: Konda
entries.content: Konda Village is a location on Narukami Island, Inazuma. A small and picturesque town, which is known for its signature dish, Konda Stew. located outside of Inazuma City.

entries.name: The Sakura Tree
entries.content: The Sakura tree is located in the Narukami Grand Shrine. Cherry trees are found throughout Inazuma. sanctuary surrounded by the huge Sacred Sakura Tree. The Sacred Sakura is in constant bloom, symbolizing Narukami's eternity.

entries.name: Narukami Grand
entries.content: Narukami Grand Shrine: The largest shrine in Inazuma. It is dedicated to his Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho. Yae Miko is in charge of the shrine and is considered the most experienced member.

entries.name: Mount
entries.content: Mount Yougou: Home of the Narukami Grand Shrine. you can climb to the top of the mountain step by step. After going through the many Torii gates, he finds the shrine maiden Yae Miko.

entries.name: Eternity
entries.content: Eternity: Shogun Raiden pursues the goal of it's creator Ei, The "Eternity". refers to humanity's quest for transcendence and immortality through the knowledge, wisdom, and cultural legacy of Inazuma.

entries.name: Visions
entries.content: Visions are gifts bestowed on humans that are recognized by the Gods or Archons. They are orbs that allow their owners to wield the elements. They grant the user elemental abilities based on their given Vision item.

entries.name: Dendro
entries.content: Dendro is one of the seven Elements. Dendro users can use plants to attack or protect themselves. It is related to nature.

entries.name: Inazuma
entries.content:
Inazuma is one of the seven regions of Teyvat. It is an archipelagic region close to Liyue, which worships Beelzebul/Ei.
Subareas: Narukami Island.

entries.name: Enemies
entries.content: Enemies in Teyvat: (Automatons, The Abyss, Elemental Lifeforms, Mystical Beasts, Hilichurls, Fatui, slimes.)

entries.name: Chinju
entries.content: Chinju Forest: A mysterious forest located at the foot of Mount Yougou, in Inazuma. It always seems to be dark. Here one can find torii gates scattered throughout the forest and abandoned shrines hidden in the depths.

entries.name: Liyue
entries.content: Liyue is one of the seven regions of Teyvat. It is the nation that worships Rex Lapis. subareas: Bishui Plain, Lisha, Minlin, Sea of Clouds, The Abyss.

entries.name: Beelzebub
entries.content: Beelzebul, whose real name is Ei, is the Goddess of Eternity and Archon Electro who presides over Inazuma. She is currently in an eternal sleep in Euthymia.

entries.name: Hilichurls
entries.content: Hilichurls are primitive and highly hostile humanoid monsters that live in tribes all over Teyvat. They always wear a mask and speak the hilichurl language. they use tools and slimes for their own benefits. They are the equivalent of goblins.

entries.name: Archons
entries.content: Archons are divine beings with great control over elemental energy. Archons: Beelzebul, Morax, Barbatos, Focalors, Buer, Murata, Zarina.

entries.name: Sumeru
entries.content: Sumeru is one of the seven regions of Teyvat. It is the nation that worships the Minor Lord Kusanali (also know as Nahida). Sub-areas: Dharma Forest, Great Red Arena, Strip of Sands.

entries.name: Dark sea
entries.content: The Dark Sea is a term that refers to any location beyond the continent of Teyvat. Because they are not within Teyvat's boundaries, those who dwell there do not live under the dominion of The Seven.

entries.name: Khaenri'ah
entries.content: The kingdom of Khaenri'ah is an unprecedented region. It is not part of the continent of Teyvat and is not under the control of The Seven. Khaenri'ah never had a god. It is a powerful nation, built exclusively by humans.

entries.name: Celestia
entries.content:
Celestia is a mysterious place that very few people understand. It is the floating island that can be seen in the sky above Teyvat and the residence of the gods.
It is said that only mortals who perform great heroic deeds can ascend to Celestia and attain godhood, where they will watch over their people from above. A human being with a Vision is an allogen, one with the potential to achieve godhood.

entries.name: Electro
entries.content: Electro is one of the seven Elements. Electro users can use purple high voltage abilities to attack or power up techniques. there haven't been many with Vision Electro. Related to lightning and storm.

entries.name: Anemo
entries.content: Anemo is one of the seven Elements. Anemo users can use the abilities of the rushing winds to attack or empower techniques. Some users can fly.

entries.name: Geo
entries.content: Geo is one of the seven Elements. Geo users can use abilities like resistant rocks to attack or protect themselves. It is related to the earth.

entries.name: Cryo
entries.content: Cryo is one of the seven Elements. Cryo users can use condensed ice to attack or protect themselves.

entries.name: Pyro
entries.content: Pyro is one of the seven Elements. Pyro users can use flaming fire to attack or empower techniques.

entries.name: Hydro
entries.content: Hydro is one of the seven Elements. Hydro users can use slowing water to attack or boost techniques.

entries.name: Ei Euthymia
entries.content: Using mysterious technology, Ei created Shogun Raiden, an immortal puppet, in it's own image. So that she governs inazuma, while Ei is in his eternal sleep inside Euthymia.

entries.name: Ei's Musou
entries.content: After perishing, Ei's consciousness materialized into a sword: Musou Isshin. Within Musou, the Euthymia Plane was created, where Ei's consciousness rests in his torpor.

entries.name: Musou Isshin
entries.content: Musou Isshin: It is a powerful sword of pure Electro, Shogun Raiden has performed many feats with it. This is kept hidden in the shogun's chest. She only invokes it at crucial moments.

entries.name: Slime
entries.content: Slimes are common enemies that can be found throughout Teyvat. They are not normally a threat unless they are in large groups. Being made of elemental energy, slimes are immune to damage from their own element.

entries.name: Fatui
entries.content: The Fatui are a delegation of diplomats from the Snezhnaya Palace. There is also a military detachment headed by the Eleven Heralds. His goal is to collect Gnosis from other Archons.

entries.name: Zarina
entries.content: Zarina is the Cryo Archon who presides over Snezhnaya. Leader of the Fatui, she has the ability to grant her subjects a power other than Visions, called Deception.

entries.name: Deception
entries.content: Zarina gives a Deception to loyal Fatui minions. This is more powerful than a Vision, but very unstable, dealing damage to the wearer if used often.

entries.name: Heralds
entries.content: The Eleven Heralds of the Fatui are the Zarina executive officers and lieutenants who have been given absolute authority. They are widely feared and despised by all other nations due to their deceitful reputation.

entries.name: Favonius Deception
entries.content: The Knights of Favonius appear to have done some research into the hoaxes, though their documents were partially burned, suggesting that someone may have tried to destroy the investigation.

entries.name: Heralds
entries.content: Active members of The Eleven Heralds: Pierotto, Dottore, Colombina, Pulcinella, Sandrone, Arlecchino, Tartaglia, Pantalone, Capitano.

entries.name: Palace Inaz
entries.content: The Shogun Raiden has his palace in Inazuma City, in the center of the city, where he resides. It has Japanese decorations.

entries.name: Favonius
entries.content: The Knights of Favonius: They are the order of knights that Mondstadt protects, founded by Vennessa with the help of Barbatos 1,000 years ago, to prevent aristocrats from ruling the land.

entries.name: Knights
entries.content: Currently active members of the Knights of Favonius: Varka, Jean, Kaeya, Albedo, Eula, Hertha.

entries.name: Dragonspine
entries.content: Dragonspine: is an area located in Mondstadt. It is a large mountain, surrounded by ancient ruins and snow-covered areas. Due to its extreme cold, Dragonspine is a dangerous place in Mondstadt.

entries.name: Decree
entries.content: The Vision Capture Decree: is an order given by Archon Electro, Beelzebul (most Know as "Raiden Ei"), and the Inazuma Shogunate to seize all Visions within Inazuma's borders and embed them onto a statue of a deity.

entries.name: Tenryou
entries.content: The Tenryou Commission in Inazuma is an organization dedicated to protecting the region and maintaining peace and order, led by Sakura and with connections to the region's gods and spirits.
a fantasy world where the seven elements flow and converge. Teyvat is the world and continent that serves as the primary setting of Genshin Impact.

The seven Elements of Genshin Impact are special Status Effects and types of Damage that can be applied in specific orders to trigger Elemental Reactions. they're: Anemo, Geo, Electro, Dendro, Hydro, Pyro, Cryo
One of the seven element. The name Anemo comes from the prefix for words related to wind, "anemo-," which derives from the Ancient Greek word for wind
Geo is one of the seven Elements. The name Geo comes from the prefix for words related to the Earth, "geo-," which derives from the Ancient Greek word for earth
Electro is one of the seven Elements. The name Electro comes from the prefix for words related to electricity, "electro-," which derives from the Ancient Greek word for amber

Dendro is one of the seven Elements. The name Dendro comes from the prefix used in biology for scientific names related to trees or plants, "dendro-," which derives from the Ancient Greek word for tree
Hydro is one of the seven Elements. The name Hydro comes from the prefix for words related to water, "hydro-," which derives from the Ancient Greek prefix for words related to water
Pyro is one of the seven Elements. The name Pyro comes from the prefix for words related to fire, "pyro-," which derives from the Ancient Greek word for fire
Cryo is one of the seven Elements. The name Cryo comes from the prefix for words related to freezing or ice, "cryo-," which derives from the Ancient Greek word for icy cold, frost, chill

Some beings in Teyvat are mysteriously granted Visions, which are external apparatuses that allow their owners to wield the elements. Visions take the form of crystals, each with the symbol and color of one element. Depending on the region in which they received their vision, they feature ornaments characteristic of that region.
When an allogene dies, their Vision becomes a Masterless Vision, losing its power and all indicators of its element. Sometimes, Masterless Visions will resonate with a new person. For this reason, Masterless visions are a commodity sought by the extremely rich.

Mondstadt is one of the seven regions in Teyvat. Its associated Archon is Barbatos, whose domain is Mondstadt. A city of freedom that lies in the northeast of Teyvat. From amongst mountains and wide-open plains, carefree breezes carry the scent of dandelions — a gift from the Anemo God, Barbatos — across Cider Lake to Mondstadt, which sits on an island in the middle of the lake. It Subareas is: Brightcrown Mountains, Galesong Hill, Starfell Valley, Windwail Highland, Dragonspine

Liyue is one of the seven regions in Teyvat. It is the nation that worships Rex Lapis, the Geo Archon. A bountiful harbor that lies in the east of Teyvat. Mountains stand tall and proud alongside the stone forest, that, together with the open plains and lively rivers, make up Liyue's bountiful landscape, which shows its unique beauty through each of the four seasons. It 	Subareas is: Bishui Plain, Lisha, Minlin, Qiongji Estuary, Sea of Clouds, The Chasm, The Chasm: Underground Mines

Inazuma is one of the seven regions in Teyvat. It is an archipelagic region that worships Raiden Shogun, the Electro Archon, who is also the leader of its governing body, the Inazuma Shogunate. Inazuma is located approximately 4 km southeast from Liyue Harbor and is a close neighbor with the Dark Sea. An Isolated Archipelago Far East of Teyvat. Overcome endless thunderstorms and set foot on the islands of red maple and cherry blossoms. On winding shores and towering cliffs, and in forests and mountains full of secrets. It Subareas: Narukami Island, Kannazuka, Yashiori, Island, Watatsumi Island, Seirai Island, Tsurumi Island, Enkanomiya
The Dark Sea is a term that refers to any location beyond the continent of Teyvat. Because they are not within Teyvat's boundaries, those who dwell there do not live under the dominion of The Seven.

Sumeru is one of the seven regions in Teyvat. It is the nation that worships Lesser Lord Kusanali, the Dendro Archon. The city of scholars located in the west-central part of Teyvat. A fantastical nation of both lush rainforest and barren desert, where countless fruits of wisdom grow and are buried. Whether Travelers travel from afar through the forest to reach the academy city or delve deep into the desert to discover the historical ruins of the red desert, a wealth of valuable knowledge awaits them here. It main Areas: Dharma Forest, Great Red Sand, Girdle of the Sands

Celestia is a mysterious location that very few people understand. It is the floating island that can be seen in the sky above Teyvat, and the residence of the gods.
It is said that only mortals who perform great, heroic feats can ascend to Celestia and achieve godhood, where they will watch over their people from above. A human with a Vision is an allogene — one with the potential to reach godhood.

Khaenri'ah, also known as the Kingdom of Khaenri'ah, is an unreleased region. It is not part of the continent of Teyvat and is not under the purview of The Seven. Khaenri'ah was a nation without a god — not because it had a god that died or abandoned them, but because it never had a god to begin with. It was a powerful nation, built purely by humans, an unprecedented flourishing and glorious civilization — it was the pride of humankind.

The Chasm is a subregion and an area located in The Chasm, Liyue. In the recent past, a series of mysterious accidents led the entire mine to be closed, putting its workers out of a job. However, the Liyue Qixing is gradually reopening the area, thus allowing miners to resume working. Beneath the Seven-Star Array is the Underground Mines.

Enemies in Genshin Impact are creatures that can be defeated by players. They can be classified by their difficulty type (Common Enemies, Elite Enemies, Normal Bosses, and Weekly Bosses), by their family (Automatons, The Abyss, Elemental Lifeforms, Mystical Beasts, Hilichurls, Fatui, Other Human Factions, and Enemies of Note), or some other form of grouping
Items in Genshin Impact are individual objects or units that players can obtain. Most items can be accessed from the Inventory

General Items:
Artifacts - Equipments used to increase the Attributes of characters.
Namecards - Backgrounds used to display in the Player Profile.
Weapons - Equipment used by characters to attack.
Character Development Items - Items used to upgrade characters.
Food - Items characters and the Party can be fed with obtain buffs.
Potions - Items that can add buffs to the Party.
Fishing Rods - Rods used to go Fishing.
Furnishings - Objects that can be placed in the Serenitea Pot.
Gadgets - Tools used by the player to interact with the world.
Materials - Items found in the world used to upgrade characters or create other items.
Quest Items - Items obtained during Quests to submit or keep.

Precious Items: 
Adventure Items - Items found during exploration to submit.
Bundles - Packs of items bought or earned
Currencies - Items used to exchange for other items.
Reliquary - Items uses to obtain Artifacts.
Sigils - Items found during exploration unique to each region that can be exchanged.
Very Special Item - Birthday Cake for the Traveler.
Wishing Items - Currencies used to perform Wishes.

Chests in Genshin Impact are objects that can be found around the world of Teyvat. Opening chests usually rewards the player with Primogems, Adventure EXP, Sigils, Mora, and a random assortment of Weapons, Artifacts, and Character EXP Materials. There are also Achievements that are granted upon opening a certain number of chests within a region. Types of Chests: Common, Exquisite, Precious, Luxurious, Remarkable. Additionally, some chests are hidden and have to be dug up from the ground. These are marked with either a shovel or some other sign. Treasure Hoarders are also an indicator of a hidden chest. When walking near their location, the option to "Dig" will appear, and then the chest will appear.nSome chests are encased in Dendro Vines, which have to be burned with Pyro to access. Others are encased in rocks, which have to be destroyed (e.g., via Claymore, Geo, or Plunging Attacks) to access.

Artifacts are items in Genshin Impact that can be equipped on Characters to increase their Stats. There are 5 types of Artifacts that can be equipped: Flower of Life, Plume of Death,  Sands of Eon,  Goblet of Eonothem, and Circlet of Logos. Only one of each type can be equipped on a character at a time. It vary from 1-star to 5-star with 1-star is the weakest and 5-star is the strongest.
Artifacts can be obtained in the following ways:
Investigation Spots
Chests
Destroying Tumbleweeds
Defeating Elite Enemies and Bosses
Claiming rewards from Petrified Trees in Domains of Blessing
Acquiring Chamber Bounties in the Spiral Abyss
Currencies in Teyvat allow for the acquisition of items from Shops.
Shops are run by NPCs that sell Items to players. Most shops will restock their wares every day. For a detailed list of the items each shop offers, visit the Vendor's page.

Mora is the main currency unit used to purchase various items and upgrades in Genshin Impact. It is also used in crafting, the upgrade of Artifacts, and leveling characters.
The currency is accepted worldwide in Teyvat. It is also considered a "catalyst" which can bring about physical transformation, which explains its usage in crafting. There are numerous ways to acquire Mora and it is a common reward for many tasks. They include:
Claiming rewards from Blossoms of Wealth using Original Resin
Completing Daily Commissions
Completing Quests
Opening Chests 
Completing Bounties and Requests for Reputation
Killing Enemies in the world
Destroying 1-Star to 4-Star Artifacts
Completing various Events

The Adventurers' Guild, is an organization that serves as an adventurer-for-hire service for the people and other organizations in the seven nations of Teyvat. The Guild collates all the complex word-of-mouth information it receives and redistributes it in the form of quests and adventures assigned to adventurers.

Little is known about the origins of the Adventurers' Guild. However, based on Lan's dialogue, the guild's main headquarters is based in Snezhnaya.

By speaking to Katheryne, the player can:

Claim Bonus Daily Commission Rewards
Claim Adventure Rank Rewards
on a scale of 1 to 100. the bigger the level the stronger character/monster get
EXP gained from quests, defeating enemies, and claiming Boss rewards is given to each member of your party, regardless of participation. Characters not in your active party will not receive EXP.
Brightcrown Mountains is an area located in Mondstadt. Subareas : Brightcrown Canyon and Stormterror's Lair

Brightcrown Canyon is a subarea located in Brightcrown Mountains, Mondstadt.

The northeastern part of the canyon contains the eastern entrance to Stormterror's Lair, which was formerly the capital city of Decarabian's Mondstadt.

Stormterror's Lair is a subarea located in Brightcrown Mountains, Mondstadt.

It was once the capital of Old Mondstadt, ruled by the God of Storms, Decarabian. After he was slain in an uprising, Barbatos took his place and reshaped the land. The people then moved the capital to an island in the middle of Cider Lake, where the City of Mondstadt remains to this day.

Five hundred years ago, victorious but grievously injured by the corrupted dragon Durin, the Dragon of the East Dvalin fell into a deep slumber in the ruins of the former capital. However, the people of Mondstadt forgot about him and when he reawakened; they feared him and called him "Stormterror" — giving the region its current name. This, along with the pain from the poisonous blood clots inflicted by Durin, allowed him to be manipulated by the Abyss Order.

Dragonspine, historically known as Vindagnyr, is an area located in Mondstadt.

It is a vast mountain, engulfed with ancient ruins and snow-capped areas, and also containing the remains of Durin. It was named Vindagnyr prior to Durin's fall.

There are some peculiarities with how the snow gathers but never melts on the mountain. Due to its extreme cold, Dragonspine is also one of the most dangerous places in Mondstadt.
Dragonspine subarea is: Entombed City - Ancient Palace, Entombed City – Outskirts, Snow-Covered Path, Starglow Cavern, Wyrmrest Valley, Skyfrost Nail

Decarabian's Tower	Located in the middle of Stormterror's Lair and is first scaled as part of the Archon Quest Empty Abode. As its name implies, it was where the God of Storms once resided and overlooked his people.
Galesong Hill is an area located in Mondstadt.

Starfell Valley is an area located in Mondstadt.

It is considered the most diverse region of Mondstadt,spreading far from the tip of Stormbearer Point to the ends of the Whispering Woods. It is also home to the City of Mondstadt in Cider Lake. The area also consists of abundant lakes and tree variety.

The area is where the Knights of Favonius's duties primarily takes place,protecting locals and travelers alike with guards patrolling around the area.
Starfell Valley subareas is: Cider Lake, City of Mondstadt, Starfell Lake, Starsnatch Cliff, Stormbearer Mountains, Stormbearer Point, Thousand Winds Temple, Whispering Woods

Windwail Highland is an area located in Mondstadt.

It is home to the idyllic town of Springvale and the chief winery of Mondstadt, Dawn Winery. It also spans far across the wolf-ruled Wolvendom.

It is one of the more rustic areas around Mondstadt having clear springs, orchards and lush forests; until one reaches to Wolvendom, which is engulfed in higher enemy activity and is usually avoided by locals.
Windwail Highland subareas is: Dawn Winery, Springvale, Wolvendom

Ancient Palace	An ancient city that lies silent beneath the eternal ice.
Look for clues and investigate the secret of a now-destroyed kingdom: Snow-Tombed Starsilver.
Outskirts of an Ancient City.

Nail is the area of Dragonspine's peak. Unlocking access to this area is part of the World Quest In the Mountains. Attempting to access this area early by scaling Dragonspine will result in Paimon remarking that it's far too cold before the player is forced to teleport away.
A snowy path leading deeper into Dragonspine
A great cavern spanning the depths of Dragonspine. Peculiar glowing vegetation grows throughout the cavern, illuminating even the deepest, darkest passages with its frigid glow.
The final resting place of the black dragon. The life force exuding from the dragon's core has dyed the steep valley's silvery snow in scarlet red. Has a glowing red cave of interest.
Galesong hill Subareas is: Cape Oath, Dadaupa Gorge, Falcon Coast, Musk Reef, Windrise
In the southeast corner of Mondstadt's surrounds lies a cape that borders with Galesong Hill.

Home to three important hilichurl tribes: the Meaty tribe, the Sleeper tribe, and the Eclipse tribe.
Within it also lies the Sword Cemetery, which witnessed the battle against the monsters of Khaenri'ah.
Stretching eastward from Windrise to the sea, Falcon Coast — together with Cape Oath — shelters the sea from three sides, creating a bay that sits east of Mondstadt.
Located off Cape Oath. The main feature on the island is the entrance to the Spiral Abyss.

A plain believed to be the location where Vennessa had ascended to Celestia, where she became a god and now watches over Mondstadt as the Falcon of the West of the Four Winds. The massive oak tree is believed to have grown there after she ascended.
A natural freshwater lake that surrounds the City of Mondstadt.

Mondstadt is the main city of the namesake nation. Located in the west part of Starfell Valley on a large island in Cider Lake, Mondstadt features cobblestone streets and several windmills surrounded by a large stone castle wall on the east lower end. A statue of the Anemo Archon watches over the city, with the Favonius Cathedral in the back.
Located east of Cider Lake.
Located in the eastern part of Starfell Valley.
Located in the northern part of Starfell Valley, once a place to observe upcoming storms.
The northeasternmost area of Mondstadt. The coast just south of the area is where the Traveler begins their journey across Teyvat with Paimon.
An ancient amphitheater. It may have been used as an arena back in the Aristocratic Period, where slaves were made to fight each other for the satisfaction of the old nobles.
A small road cuts through these dense and deep woods, where the Traveler first meets Venti and Dvalin.

The chief winery in Mondstadt and specializes in Dandelion Wine. Owned by the Ragnvindr Clan for several generations, its current owner, Diluc, inherited it four years ago after the untimely passing of his father, Crepus.

A small town in the south east part of Windwail Highland, Springvale features dirt-paved areas and one-story tan houses with blue tiled roofs. One singular windmill watches over the town, with a naturally-occurring spring right below it.
Home to Andrius, Wolf of the North of the Four Winds, and his wolf pack.
Liyue areas is: Bishui Plain, Lisha, Minlin, Qiongji Estuary, Sea of Clouds, The Chasm, The Chasm: Underground Mines.

Bishui Plain is an area located in Liyue.

The Bishui River passes through it.

The Bishui River is a major river in Liyue that is primarily located in Bishui Plain but spans all areas except Lisha.

The Bishui River flows from northwest Liyue through Dihua Marsh where it splits, one part ending in the lake near Dawn Winery, the other in Qiongji Estuary where it flows into the Sea of Clouds. It has several tributaries.
There are 6 subareas in Bishui Plain: Dihua Marsh, Qingce Village, Sal Terrae, Stone Gate, Wangshu Inn, Wuwang Hill

Dihua Marsh is an alluvial plane shaped by the Bishui River. It is south of Stone Gate and north of Wangshu Inn. Sal Terrae lies to the east.
There is a Statue of The Seven located on the northern end of Dihua Marsh, along the main road.

This village is said to be a retirement spot for the elderly.[1] Due to the quietness, many people moved away in favor of other locations, leaving mostly elderly people watching over their grandchildren.
Buildings in Qingce Village have a simple architectural style, and most are made of wood with blue roofs. Qingce Village is home to a community center where Granny Ruoxin can be found, the mill owned by Ms. Bai, a tea shop owned by Pops Kai, the Fanmu Carpenter shop owned by Master Lu, and a market. The Qingce Village Bulletin Board is where advertisements and other postings by residents can be read.
The northwestern part of Qingce Village, located closer to the water, features a number of terraced fields of flowers. Glaze Lilies can be found there, as well as Slimes. According to legends, the terraced fields were the scales of the Chi.
It was founded by Havria, the God of Salt, and was the last sanctuary she presided over for her people after conceding much of her land during the Archon War in hopes of peace.
It is the convergence of the roads to Dawn Winery (northeast), Wuwang Hill and Qingce Village (northwest), and Dihua Marsh and Liyue Harbor (south).

According to Zhongli, Wangshu Inn was built tall to provide visibility and is a strategic location that must be defended.
As most of the patrons that stop here are traveling merchants, the inn provides an area for them to trade and set up stalls. The view from the top of the inn is jaw-dropping — weather permitting, you can see all the way to Mt. Qingce and Jueyun Karst in the distance.
Legend amongst the stalls says that the tower of the inn hides a mysterious secret, but that's as far as the legend goes, as no one has ever been able to verify the claims.
The inn itself is run by Verr Goldet and her husband, Huai'an, who are both secret agents under the Liyue Qixing reporting directly to Ningguang. The commercial aspect of the inn is a front to their real task of covertly assisting Xiao in his excursions of excising plagues from Liyue.
The area is known for its eerie atmosphere, as the skies will always be dark gray regardless of whether it is daytime or nighttime.
Lisha (Chinese: 璃沙郊 Líshā-jiāo, "Glaze Sand Outskirts") is an area located in Liyue.
There are 3 subareas in Lisha:Dunyu Ruins, Lingju Pass, Qingxu Pool

Pervases's Temple is a point of interest located in Lisha, Liyue.

It is a temple dedicated to the deceased Yaksha, Pervases, and contains a statue dedicated to him. It originally appears as a dilapidated house, before being restored upon the completion of World Quest Hereafter: All is Well in Series Hereafter.
It is one of the three locations where the Nameless Treasures can be found.
The area is mostly made of ruins with many puzzles to solve.
The ruins there are said to have been left behind by an evil god, and it was underwater until the end of the Archon War.
Minlin (Chinese: 珉林 Mínlín, "Forest of Jade-Like Stone") is an area located in Liyue.
Minlin Subareas is: Cuijue Slope, Jueyun Karst, Huaguang Stone Forest, Mt. Aocang, Mt. Hulao, Nantianmen, Qingyun Peak, Tianqiu Valley,
Located within the heart of this region are the Nine Pillars and a temple to the center. While within the vicinity of the pillars, the sky will darken.
It is said to be the place where the adepti live. Normally no one dares to try to set foot here, but some brave or desperate people still try to seek the adepti for good fortune.
Surrounded by three mountains: Mt. Aocang to the north, Qingyun Peak to the east, and Mt. Hulao to the southwest.
Home of the Adeptus Cloud Retainer.
The large pieces of Amber Rock found along the mountain are formed by flowers Mountain Shaper planted to keep out intruders.

This region notably features the Dragon-Queller, a large tree used to seal Azhdaha, whom Jiu worships. The dragon has begun merging with the tree, using its roots to connect to the ley lines and draw power from them.
Home of the Adeptus Moon Carver. Also features the Dwelling in the Clouds — a small floating island high above this mountain, which was created by Cloud Retainer at an unknown point in the past.
Located in the southeastern part of Minlin.
Qiongji Estuary (Chinese: 琼玑野 Qióngjī-yě) is an area located in Liyue.
Qiongji Estuary subareas is: Guili Plains, Luhua Pool, Mingyun Village, Yaoguang Shoal

It was the central area of the Guili Assembly, the ancient civilization ruled by Guizhong, the God of Dust, and Morax, the God of Geo.
The location's name is derived from their names,[Note 1] and it is also called the Plains of Returning and Departing based on the characters taken from their names.
During the Archon War, Guizhong died trying to defend her people, and the place was destroyed. After her death, Rex Lapis took his people and brought them south of Mt. Tianheng, where he established Liyue Harbor.
It is a unique landscape consisting of brightly-colored pools, watched over by two statues.

It is home to several scattered mining deposits, but many of them have since dried up, with the remaining few ores unable to keep up the village's survival. The inhabitants have since left westward towards Liyue Harbor and The Chasm for a better opportunity. Hilichurls have since moved in to the area to make use of the leftover facilities.
Three small mining tunnels exist in the area around the village where one can find deposits of Iron Chunks, Noctilucous Jade, and Cor Lapis.

It lies south of Mingyun Village and east of Guili Plains.
To the far east side of Yaoguang Shoal is an unnamed "hidden" location dubbed Heart Island by players, for the heart-shaped puzzle located on the island. Unlocking the Luxurious Chest buried on the island requires standing on the heart with another player in Co-Op, and grants the Wonders of the World achievement Unswerving.
The Sea of Clouds is an area located in Liyue.
Sea of Clouds subareas is: Guyun Stone Forest, Liyue Harbor, Mt. Tianheng

An archipelago of seven large islands and smaller offshoots.
According to legend, this is where Rex Lapis defeated a god and sea monster known as Osial, and the jagged cliffs protruding from the islands at Guyun are in fact the remnants of the stone lances he used in that battle.

The main city of the Liyue nation.
During the Archon War, after Guizhong died, Rex Lapis brought his people south of Mt. Tianheng, to found what is now known as Liyue Harbor.
A mountain west of Liyue Harbor, raised by Morax when he first descended upon Liyue, and there people congregated to mine ore from the mountains.
Sea of Clouds Points of Interest is: Alcor, Feiyun Slope, Chihu Rock, Yujing Terrace, Emerald Maple Inn, Golden House
The flagship of The Crux. While it is normally helmed by Captain Beidou, she has returned to Liyue Harbor for business and left the ship to her men.

The Crux (Chinese: 南十字 Nánshízì, "The Southern Cross") is an armed fleet based in Liyue Harbor and led by Captain Beidou. The Crux is famous throughout Liyue for their daring adventures and rich bounties.
Its flagship, the Alcor, can be found (and boarded) off the shores of Guyun Stone Forest, by the southeastern end of the island Domain of Guyun is on.

Feiyun Slope is the northeastern area in Liyue Harbor. It is the first area entered upon entering Liyue Harbor via the main road from Mondstadt. A sloped staircase separates the upper and lower levels of the area. From the northern Teleport Waypoint in Liyue Harbor, turn left at the T-section to enter the upper Feiyun Slope area.
Chihu Rock is the southern end of Liyue Harbor, between Feiyun Slope and the South Wharf. It is primarily a commercial area where many stores and vendors can be found.
Yujing Terrace is the area on the northwestern side of Liyue Harbor, to the left of the northern Teleport Waypoint on the World Map. After teleporting to that waypoint, head straight and turn right.

The Emerald Maple Inn is an inn located west of the Statue of The Seven at the Sea of Clouds, Liyue, and overlooks Luhua Pool. Due to its relatively remote location, its proprietor, Mr. Zhu, struggles to get patrons.
The Golden House is where all of Teyvat's Mora is minted. When Rex Lapis died, his corpse, the Exuvia, was moved here by the Liyue Qixing.
The chasm Subareas is: Cinnabar Cliff, Fuao Vale, Glaze Peak, Lumberpick Valley, The Chasm's Maw, The Surface, Tiangong Gorge
Cinnabar Cliff is a subarea located in The Chasm, Liyue. Cinnabar Cliff is considered a tourist spot, but locals never go there.[
Fuao Vale (Chinese: 伏鳌谷 Fú'áo-gǔ) is a subarea located in The Chasm, Liyue. This is the site of the deadly battle between Azhdaha and Rex Lapis.
Glaze Peak is a subarea located in The Chasm, Liyue.
Lumberpick Valley is a subarea located in The Chasm, Liyue.

The Chasm's Maw is a subarea located in The Chasm, Liyue.
It serves as the entrance to The Chasm's underground mines.
The Surface is a subarea located in The Chasm, Liyue.
Tiangong Gorge is a subarea located in The Chasm, Liyue.
The Chasm: Underground Mines subareas is: Ad-Hoc Main Tunnel, Nameless Ruins, Stony Halls, The Chasm: Main Mining Area, The Glowing Narrows, The Serpent's Cave, Underground Waterway.
The Chasm: Underground Mines Points of Interest is: Chasm Exploration Team Camp, Spiritstone, The Chasm's Bed, The Chasm Withered Tree.
The entrance to the Chasm's Underground Mines. It consists of large tunnels with platforms on both sides, it functions as a passageway to The Chasm: Main Mining Area.

Relics of an ancient civilization with ties to Khaenri'ah. The entire structure is upside down, fixed to the ceiling for unknown reasons. There are plethora of tunnels connecting it to many other deeper areas.

A sphere shaped cave with a Spiritstone shard in the center, the crystal has seemingly affected the surroundings to create a spiraling rock formation around itself. The pit below it leads to the Nameless Ruins.

A spacious and large area west of the Ad-Hoc Main Tunnel. It is where most of the ore is dug from and where most activity in the Chasm is centered around. A blocked tunnel at the end leads to the Stony Halls.
A cave system located at the deepest levels of the Chasm, the name is derived from a great many number of glowing plants present there. It is the last area before the Spiritstone.
A dug cave with many smaller caverns on all sides, it was excavated by a Ruin Serpent. It is connected to Ad-Hoc Main Tunnel via a tunnel in the north and one in the east.
A system of water bodies located south of the Ad-Hoc Main Tunnel, it has an abundance of flora due to its high moisture.
Located at the Icon Refine Adjuvant. The camp set up by the Chasm Exploration Team while investigating the underground mines.
Located west of The Glowing Narrows. It resembles the Skyfrost Nail.
Located east of The Chasm: Main Mining Area. The Shriveled Seed can be obtained at this location.
An area of distorted spacetime located right under the Spiritstone, accessed during the Archon Quest Interlude Chapter: Act II - Perilous Trail.
Located north of The Chasm: Main Mining Area. It looks like the ancient white tree from Dragonspine.

Enkanomiya (Japanese: 淵下宮 Enkanomiya, "Palace Below the Depths"), originally known as Byakuyakoku (Japanese: 白夜国 Byakuyakoku, "Land of the White Night / Midnight Sun")[1] and Tokoyokoku (Japanese: 常世国 Tokoyokoku, "Eternal Country"), is an area located in Inazuma.
It can be entered via a deep pool east of Sangonomiya Shrine, and legend has it that the Watatsumi people originated from here.[2] Enkanomiya is located under Watatsumi Island, and can be considered either part of Teyvat even though it is somewhat disconnected from it, or fully separate and part of the Dark Sea instead.
To enter Enkanomiya, the seals on the five Goshou Rocks need to be broken for the pearls located within the shrines for the Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep, which would allow entry to Enkanomiya, provided that the spirit veins connecting Enkanomiya and Watatsumi Island are flowing smoothly and a person whose heart is "as clear as water." According to legend, the key was forged from Orobashi's blood.
Enkanomiya subareas is: Dainichi Mikoshi, Evernight Temple, The Narrows, The Serpent's Bowels, The Serpent's Heart, Yachimatahiko's Locus, Yachimatahime's Locus, Kunado's Locus.
enkanomiya Points of Interest is: Dragonbone Flower, The Altar at The Serpent's Heart, The Emanant Skylight, Tokoyo Reisen, Vishap Research Lab	.
The central area of Enkanomiya, named after Enkanomiya's artificial sun that was created by Aberaku no Mikoto in order to protect Byakuyakoku from the Dragonheir of the Depths.
Located east of Dainichi Mikoshi.
Located northwest of Dainichi Mikoshi.
The pathway towards the main areas of Enkanomiya.
Located south of Dainichi Mikoshi.
The northernmost area of Enkanomiya. It is initially hidden from the map and can be unlocked and shown on the map by starting the Erebos' Secret questline.
The northeasternmost area of Enkanomiya. It is initially hidden from the map and can be unlocked and shown on the map by starting the Erebos' Secret questline.
The southernmost area of Enkanomiya. It is initially hidden from the map and can be unlocked and shown on the map by starting the Erebos' Secret questline.
A giant flower in The Serpent's Bowels. In the world quest Lotus Eater, the Traveler waters this flower using the Waters of Lethe to obtain the Dragonbone Orb.
Used to enter in Altar Patterns to obtain rewards or advance a quest.
Found in The Narrows, Evernight Temple, and The Serpent's Heart. Ghostfish here can be used to will lift the player up towards a Time Tunnel which will take them to one of the three locuses.
Located north of Dainichi Mikoshi. This area is not marked on the map.

Kannazuka (Japanese: 神かん無な塚づか Kanna-dzuka) is an area located in Inazuma.
Behind the rocky outcrops lies Mikage Furnace, the largest smelting facility in Inazuma and is also home to the battlefront fortress of the Shogunate's forces.
It is considered to be disputed territory between the Inazuma Shogunate and the Watatsumi Army. The area neither belongs to both armies and neither Inazuman faith nor Sangonomiya faith has any influence. For this reason, this area is called Kannazuka, which means "the hill where no gods reside."
Kannazuka subareas is: Tatarasuna, Kujou Encampment
Kannazuka Points of Interest is: Mikage Furnace, The Arsenal

Legend has it that Kannazuka means "the hill where no gods reside." Until now, Kannazuka is disputed territory between the Shogunate and Sangonomiya.
Kannazuka has a mountainous terrain with high steep cliffs. In the midst of the rocky outcrops lies Mikage Furnace, the largest smelting facility in Inazuma. This is where Jade Steel is made, a rare material that is used in Inazuma to forge swords.

The Shogunate's military camp in Kannazuka.
There will always be an irreconcilable conflict between the people of Narukami who believe in the Raiden Shogun and the people of Sangonomiya who believe in Watatsumi Omikami. The strife between both parties has only worsened since the Vision Hunt Decree was enforced.
To put down the Sangonomiya rebellion, the Tenryou Commission has stationed the Shogun's Army here. Compared to the Sangonomiya forces, the Shogun's Army has more troops, is better trained, and is well-equipped. Victory seems assured for the latter.

Revealed as a sneak peek in the Version 1.5 Special Program as: "The largest smelting facility in all the islands of Inazuma, surrounded by jagged, rocky terrain. War has brought production to a halt."
A cave located underneath Tatarasuna, near the Mikage Furnace.

Narukami Island (Japanese: 鳴なる神かみ島じま Narukami-jima) is an area located in Inazuma.
The area spans across Ritou, its port of entry, to Mt. Yougou which is home to the Grand Narukami Shrine, and on its coast is Inazuma City. It also has a mass of dense forests under the moonlight and underwater ruins alike.
It is where the Inazuma Shogunate primarily takes rule, enforcing policies and laws in accordance to the Sakoku Decree. Inazuman public festivals and cultural events are being held here.
Narukami subareas is: Amakane Island, Araumi, Byakko Plain, Chinju Forest, Jinren Island, Inazuma City, Mt. Yougou, Grand Narukami Shrine, Ritou, Konda Village, Kamisato Estate.
Narukami Points of Interest is: Depths of Mt. Yougou, Hanamizaka, Sacred Sakura, Tenryou, Tenshukaku, Uyuu Restaurant.
Amakane Island A festival island located to the north-west of Inazuma City.
Features a large underground area.
Separating Konda Village and Inazuma City, many wild foxes can be found here.

A tranquil and mysterious forest located at the foot of Mt. Yougou.
Here one can find Tanuki statues everywhere, torii gates scattered throughout the forest, and abandoned shrines hidden in the depths... Like a flowing river, they tell of legends meandering into a forgotten past.
Rumor has it that when walking in Chinju Forest, you may encounter mysterious beings who like to play pranks...
A group of broken isles at the northernmost tip of Inazuma.

Inazuma's most lively and prosperous area, where most of Inazuma's population lives. From Hanamizaka to the streets of the city, you can follow the trail to visit local traditional shops and sample Inazuma specialties.
The Tenryou Commission is also located in the city, governing matters concerning public order and security, as well as the Shogunate's military affairs.
At the top of Inazuma City is Tenshukaku, where the Raiden Shogun resides and rules over Inazuma.
A mountain on Narukami Island, home to the Grand Narukami Shrine and Sacred Sakura.

The largest shrine in Inazuma, located at the peak of Mt. Yougou. It is dedicated to Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho.
For those who have wishes, they can climb to the top of the mountain one step at a time. For those who have gained the favor of Electro, they can use the Thunder Spheres to fly up and reach the shrine surrounded by the huge Sacred Sakura Tree. The Sacred Sakura is in constant bloom, symbolizing the eternity of Narukami.
After passing through the many torii gates, find the shrine maiden to draw a fortune slip and ask for Narukami's blessing.

To properly explore the realm of the Shogun during this time of the Sakoku Decree, you must first pass the checkpoint in Ritou.
Ritou is under the jurisdiction of the Kanjou Commission and people need various documents to be granted passage. However, to get the necessary Travel Permit, you have to go through a very complicated procedure and have the right connections.
Without the Travel Permit, you can only stop briefly in Ritou. You will see other outlanders who are also stuck there, together looking out upon the desolate landscape of the fishing village with red maples and green roof tiles.
A small village located outside of Inazuma City.
The residence of the Kamisato Clan that oversees the Yashiro Commission.
Mentioned as a sneak peek in the Version 1.6 Special Program as: "The plant life here has grown gnarled and unnatural from growing in uttermost darkness. Something twisted seems to be sealed here."
Hanamizaka occupies the outskirts of Inazuma City between Byakko Plain and Tenryou.
Sakura Tree located in the Grand Narukami Shrine.
City	Among the streets of Tenryou is the famous Commercial Street — the busiest street in all of Inazuma.

The Tenshukaku compound occupies the southern half of Inazuma City. It is the highest point in the city and serves as the residence of the Raiden Shogun and as the headquarters of the Tenryou Commission.
A restaurant referred to in Someone's Drifting Bottle and located in Hanamizaka.

Seirai Island (Japanese: セイライ島じま Seirai-jima) is an area located in Inazuma.
It is said that the island once experienced a calamity and the center of the island was enveloped by a perpetual thunderstorm. This storm has resulted in the unique geography of the island. Until the Seirai Stormchasers quest series is completed, the center of the island is constantly afflicted with Balethunder and lightning that targets the player. Even after completing the quest series, Electro Water will still persist at the center of the island, although it can be cleared by a nearby puzzle, which will reveal a large hole in the middle.
Seirai Island subareas is: Amakumo Peak, Asase Shrine, Fort Hiraumi, Koseki Village, Seiraimaru.
Seirai Island Points of Interest is: The Summit, The Lake, Underground Ruins.

Long ago, Kanna Kapatcir was slain here, while the power of its lingering hatred and regret was suppressed by wards maintained by the Asase Shrine. During the Seirai Rebellion around 500 years ago, Asase Hibiki unsealed the wards, causing the Thunder Manifestation to appear and devastate the area with a massive Electro storm.
The shrine was established to suppress the lingering power of Kanna Kapatcir, also known as the Thunderbird.
Located in the northeastern part of Seirai Island.
Located northwest of Amakumo Peak.
The area takes its name after the "Seiraimaru," the flagship of Ako Domeki's fleet which was destroyed here.
The fragmented summit of Amakumo Peak is now home to the Thunder Manifestation.

The lake at the base of Amakumo Peak is filled with Electro Water and the surrounding area is roamed by many Ruin Sentinels. However, by solving the Light-Up Tile Puzzle, a mechanism is unlocked that drains the water from the area and nullifies its Electro effect. After being drained, ruins leading to an underground settlement are revealed.
Available after draining the lake at Amakumo Peak.

Tsurumi Island (Japanese: 鶴つる観み Tsurumi) is an area located in Inazuma.

Shrouded in a dense Fog, Tsurumi Island was home to two ancient civilizations. One buried deep underground, before the time of the Thunderbird's reign, known as the Pre-Thunderbird Civilization. The other coming some time after, the civilization where a tribe worshipped Kanna Kapatcir (becoming known as the Thunderbird Civilization) and were subsequently wiped out by it. The land has since somewhat regrown and is now inhabited by hilichurls, riftwolves and automatons.
Tsurumi Island subareas is: Autake Plains, Chirai Shrine, Moshiri Ceremonial Site, Mt. Kanna, Oina Beach, Shirikoro Peak, Wakukau Shoal.

Autake Plains (Japanese: アウタケ平原 Autake Heigen) is a subarea located in Tsurumi Island, Inazuma.
Most of Autake Plains was covered by an unremovable Fog, even after the completion of A Particularly Particular Author; if the Player stays inside the fog for too long without a Stormstone nearby, they will be teleported to the nearest Teleport Waypoint outside of the fog.
After the completion of The Sun-Wheel and Mt. Kanna, the fog will permanently disappear, allowing easier exploration.
Chirai Shrine (Japanese: チライ社殿 Chirai Shaden) is a subarea located in Tsurumi Island, Inazuma.
Moshiri Ceremonial Site (Japanese: モシリ祭場 Moshiri Saijou) is a subarea located in Tsurumi Island, Inazuma.
Mt. Kanna (Japanese: カンナ山 Kanna-zan) is a subarea located in Tsurumi Island, Inazuma.
Oina Beach (Japanese: オイナ海岸 Oina Kaigan) is a subarea located in Tsurumi Island, Inazuma.
Shirikoro Peak (Japanese: シリコロ山 Shirikoro-zan) is a subarea located in Tsurumi Island, Inazuma.
Wakukau Shoal (Japanese: ワクカウ浜 Wakukau-hama) is a subarea of Tsurumi Island.

Watatsumi Island (Japanese: 海祇わたつみ島じま Watatsumi-jima) is an area located in Inazuma.
Among these islands, it is located the farthest and on the opposite end of Narukami Island. It is known for its dense foliage in breathtaking colors which are distinct from plants found elsewhere.
Watatsumi Island subareas is: Sangonomiya Shrine, Suigetsu Pool, Bourou Village, Mouun Shrine.
A shrine located at the center of Watatsumi Island.
Located in the northeastern part of Watatsumi Island.
A small village located in the southern part of Watatsumi Island. It served as the camp where soldiers were trained during the Watatsumi Army's fight against the Shogunate.
An abandoned shrine in the western part of Watatsumi Island.

Yashiori Island (Japanese: ヤシオリ島 Yashiori-jima) is an area located in Inazuma.
At some point within the last two thousand years, the island was attacked by the Watatsumi Omikami Orobashi no Mikoto, an ancient god who created Watatsumi Island.
As a result of the heavy concentration of Tatarigami energy, the island suffers from torrential rainfall and frequent thunderstorms in the open, which in turn applies constant Wet status. Getting hit by a thunderstorm while raining can cause Electro-Charged. Until the quest Orobashi's Legacy is fully completed, this abnormal weather will remain on the island.
Yashiori Island subareas is: Fort Fujitou, Fort Mumei, Higi Village, Jakotsu Mine, Serpent's Head, Musoujin Gorge, Nazuchi Beach.
Yashiori Island Points of Interest is: Chouji's House
A military camp previously occupied by the Watatsumi Army.
A ruined area at the east side of Yashiori Island.
An abandoned village.
The southernmost area of Yashiori Island

Of the giant serpent that was defeated by the Electro Archon with the Musou no Hitotachi, only its weather-bleached remains are left today.
Although its skull still looks up at the sky defiantly, the god is already dead, and so the name of "Watatsumi Omikami" is gradually being forgotten.
Even if the giant serpent is long dead, you can still clearly feel the traces of its power left behind. Under the influence of the Tatarigami, Yashiori Island has been deserted by its inhabitants. What can be seen on the island are just endless rain and thunderstorms trying to wash away the remnants of the past.

This narrow and majestic rift valley runs through the eastern part of Yashiori Island.
This extraordinary sight is no natural formation, but rather is the result of the fight in which the Electro Archon slayed the giant serpent. The rift valley is named after the Musou no Hitotachi, a testament to the Electro Archon's skilled swordsmanship.
To this day, the remains of the giant serpent are still scattered throughout Yashiori Island. The Tatarigami that emerged from this god's remains seem to be awakening...

Located between Yashiori Island and Kannazuka, Nazuchi Beach is a place ravaged by war. On the shallow coast, apart from Violet Ibis looking for a place to rest, there are torn flags and broken arrows of prior battles, as well as broken masts and shattered deck of shipwrecks.
As a result of the war, pirates and ronin infest the place searching for loot. Even the rare Dendrobium blooms in this place...
The former residence of Chouji's family.
sumeru subregion is: Dharma Forest, Great Red Sand, Girdle of the Sands.

Dharma Forest is a subregion located in Sumeru. It is the rainforest subregion for this nation. A fragrant wind comes from the west of the rainforest, carrying stories that have never been heard.
The nation of wisdom sleeps soundly under the green veil, and all creatures sing under the cleansing rainwater. Amidst the luxuriant branches and leaves, the new chapter of the journey unfolds.
Dharma Forest Subares is: Ardravi Valley, Ashavan Realm, Avidya Forest, Lokapala Jungle, Lost Nursery, Vanarana, Vissudha Field.
Ardravi Valley is an area located in Dharma Forest, Sumeru.
Ardravi Valley Point of interest is: Dev's Cavern, Djafar Tavern, Pharos Lighthouse, Port Ormos Bulletin Board, Ruin Golem (Devantaka Mountain), Shapur Hotel, Wikala Funduq.
Ardravi Valley Subares is: Devantaka Mountain, Port Ormos, Vimara Village.

Devantaka Mountain is home to a massive Ruin Golem, which the legendary scholar Pir Kavikavus once researched, resulting in a terrible accident.
The Akasha System has no signal while on the mountain.

Port Ormos is the largest port in Sumeru and serves as a hub for trading and travel. It is located beneath two giant trees, between which a river runs from Sumeru City to the port.
Though parts of Port Ormos are under the supervision of the Akademiya, smuggling and other illegal activity is more common at Port Ormos than in Sumeru City. Prices also tend to be lower than in Sumeru City. Most long-term residents in the port are traders and laborers who grew up in the area, but a number of Eremite merceneries from various factions can also be found there. Students often come to the port when academic life gets too stressful, and it is even considered good luck to some.
Vimara Village is a small, tranquil fishing town on the river between Sumeru City and Port Ormos, and many caravans pass through the village while traveling between the two.
Dev's Cavern is a point of interest located in Ardravi Valley, Dharma Forest, Sumeru.
Djafar Tavern is a point of interest located in Port Ormos, Ardravi Valley, Dharma Forest, Sumeru.
Pharos Lighthouse is a point of interest located in Port Ormos, Ardravi Valley, Dharma Forest, Sumeru.
Port Ormos Bulletin Board, It can be found near Shapur Hotel. The messages randomly cycle through every time it is interacted with.

The Ruin Golem at Devantaka Mountain, Sumeru is one of three known Ruin Golems located in the Sumeru region, alongside the Ruin Golems at Valley of Dahri and Desert of Hadramaveth. It is featured during the World Quest Vimana Agama.

The Grove of Dreams is a place where a way to enter dreams is said to reside.[1] Like Vanarana, it has both a real and a dream version, and players can switch between the two by playing the Rhythm of the Great Dream with the Vintage Lyre at a Silapna.
It is unlocked during the Varuna Gatha World Quest Series, and is where the player first gains access to the Varuna Contraption.

Avidya Forest is an area located in Dharma Forest, Sumeru.
Avidya Forest is a lush, green forest located in eastern Sumeru. It is the main area and most populous section of Sumeru apart from Ardravi Valley. The forest is also home to Sumeru City which houses The Akademiya, and Gandharva Ville, which is the base of the Forest Watchers. The Forest Watchers have guarded the forest for many years in order to ensure the forest's survival.
Many unique flora and fauna grow in the Avidya Forest, such as Padisarahs, Nilopata Lotuses or Rukkhashava Mushrooms. Apart from Flowers, there are also different species and breeds of animals found, like Shroomboars. In the forest, you wil also find many, many special breeds of Shroomkin out in the wild.
The Avidya Forest is also the first area in Sumeru that the Traveler enters.

Also called "The City Above the Forest," it is the main outpost of Forest Rangers and is often frequented by travelers, merchants, and adventurers.

Sumeru City is known across Teyvat as the "City of Wisdom." It is under the jurisdiction of the Sumeru Akademiya and is built on top of the Divine Tree.
The city features many districts and points of interest, such as the Grand Bazaar, Zubayr Theater, Treasures Street, and more. Located in the middle to top half of the tree is The Akademiya, which serves as the main base of the Sumeru Akademiya. On top of The Akademiya rests the Sanctuary of Surasthana, which is a treetop palace where Lesser Lord Kusanali resides.

It is a forest made of enormous fluorescent mushrooms.
Mawtiyima is described as "an energy form created by the ancient dreams and memories of the forest." This energy fights against The Withering to ensure the health of the forest, and even seems to be able to communicate with the Aranara. In an ancient tongue, the name once meant "human death."
The Palace of Alcazarzaray is owned by Dori. It was designed by Kaveh and is considered to be his magnum opus.

Before completing the World Quest The Final Chapter, Mawtiyima is inaccessible. During The Final Chapter, the Traveler offers the Arahaoma to Jamikayomars, unlocking the entrance to Mawtiyima, which is infected by The Withering. The Traveler aids Aranakin, Aragaru, and Aranaga in cleaning up the pollution caused by The Withering. After completing The Final Chapter, the area is freely accessible.
It is said that the Realm of Khab is the convergence of the memories of Nara Varuna and Aranara, becoming the place where the dreams of the Barsam Flower gather.

Vanarana is an area and a subarea located in Vanarana, Dharma Forest, Sumeru.
There are two different versions of Vanarana: the one that exists in reality, and the dream version where the Aranara live (which is called Mahavanaranapna).

The Aranara are a race of plantlike forest spirits who reside in Vanarana in northern Sumeru. They are encountered in the World Quest series Aranyaka.
They were led by Greater Lord Rukkhadevata — whom they called "Queen Aranyani" — up until her disappearance.
After Lesser Lord Kusanali erased the memory of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata from the Irminsul during Where the Boat of Consciousness Lies, like any Teyvatian creatures, the Aranara also forgot her as Queen Aranyani, believing instead that they are the children of the current Dendro Archon, whom they refer to as The Lord of Verdure.

The oasis was created by King Deshret as a cemetery for the Goddess of Flowers, preserved for eternity in a single moment.

It is one of three Ruin Golems located in the Sumeru region, alongside the Ruin Golems at Devantaka Mountain and Desert of Hadramaveth.
This Ruin Golem is still operative and will shoot projectiles at the player, dealing AoE Physical DMG and causing massive knockback. Its projectiles can also destroy loose rocks.
